privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1_content:

- Required: Email address, pet information (name, breed, weight, etc.), analysis images
- Optional: Location information (when using the hospital search service)
privacy.section2_content: The collected information is used for AI health analysis, providing customized diet and exercise plans, providing nearby animal hospital search services, and service improvement.

privacy.section4_content: Information is retained until membership withdrawal or service termination, and is stored for the period prescribed by law if specified.

hardcoded.default_disclaimer: This analysis is based on AI visual assessment and published veterinary research. It does not replace professional veterinary diagnosis.
hardcoded.wsava_default: Nutritional status is the "fifth vital sign" alongside temperature and pulse. Systematic nutritional assessment can prevent disease and extend lifespan.
hardcoded.wsava_source: Source: World Small Animal Veterinary Association (WSAVA) Guidelines
hardcoded.steve_mann_default: Instead of coercive methods, "positive reinforcement training" using treats and toys is key to building trust with your dog. Understand their body language and communicate.
hardcoded.ad_pet_food_desc: Check the optimal nutritional balance based on genetic analysis results.
hardcoded.fallback_id_basis1: Broad skull with gentle stop - matches AKC Golden Retriever standard
hardcoded.fallback_id_basis2: Ear position starting at eye level, covering eyes when pulled forward - matches AKC standard
hardcoded.fallback_id_basis3: Medium-length double coat, golden to cream color range - within FCI standard color range
hardcoded.fallback_hip_recommendation: X-ray examination recommended after 12 months per AAHA guidelines
hardcoded.fallback_care_hip_check_desc: Get an official hip evaluation at 24 months per OFA recommendations.
hardcoded.fallback_care_weight_desc: Purina's 14-year study showed that maintaining proper weight delays hip dysplasia onset by an average of 1.8 years.
hardcoded.fallback_care_low_impact_desc: Swimming is the optimal exercise that doesn't strain joints. (ACVS recommended)
hardcoded.fallback_cataract_prevalence: Approximately 8.3% occurrence in Golden Retrievers (CERF/OFA Eye Registry)
hardcoded.fallback_cataract_desc: Causes vision loss due to lens opacity. Can appear early due to genetic factors, making regular eye exams crucial.
hardcoded.fallback_cataract_recommendation: ACVO recommends: Annual ophthalmic professional examination
hardcoded.fallback_care_eye_check_desc: Get annual eye exams per ACVO recommendations.
hardcoded.fallback_care_antioxidant_desc: Antioxidant nutrients such as lutein and vitamin E help maintain lens health. (NRC 2006)
hardcoded.fallback_diet_title: High-Protein, Low-Fat Diet for Golden Retrievers
hardcoded.fallback_diet_rec1: Omega-3 fatty acid supplementation for joint health (EPA+DHA 50-100mg/kg BW daily - NRC recommended)
hardcoded.fallback_diet_rec2: Low-calorie treats for weight control (within 10% of total calories - WSAVA recommended)
hardcoded.fallback_diet_rec3: High-quality, easily digestible protein (minimum 25% - AAFCO standard)
hardcoded.fallback_prohibit1: Grapes and raisins (causes kidney damage - ASPCA Poison DB)
hardcoded.fallback_prohibit3: Onions and garlic (causes red blood cell destruction - Merck Vet Manual)
hardcoded.fallback_prohibit4: Xylitol-containing products (causes acute liver failure - FDA warning)
hardcoded.fallback_exercise_title: Daily Exercise Routine for Active Retrievers
hardcoded.fallback_precaution1: Watch for heatstroke above 27°C in summer (AKC Heat Safety Guidelines)
hardcoded.fallback_precaution2: Wait at least 1 hour after meals before exercise (GDV prevention - ACVS recommended)
hardcoded.fallback_precaution3: Avoid jumping from heights to protect hip joints (OFA exercise recommendations)
hardcoded.fallback_expert_advice: Golden Retrievers are highly intelligent and active, requiring sufficient physical activity and mental stimulation. They are prone to obesity, making weight management key to their health.
hardcoded.fallback_careguide_hip_desc: Get an OFA evaluation at 24 months, then annual vet checkups thereafter.
hardcoded.fallback_careguide_weight_desc: Aim for BCS 4-5/9. Purina research shows maintaining proper weight extends lifespan by an average of 1.8 years.
hardcoded.fallback_careguide_eye_desc: Get annual ophthalmologic exams per ACVO recommendations. Early detection of hereditary cataracts is important.
hardcoded.fallback_careguide_joint_desc: Chondroitin, glucosamine, and omega-3 supplementation supports joint health. (NRC 2006 standard)
